source_text: Ἡ οὖν ὁδὸς τοῦ φωτός ἐστιν αὕτη: ἐάν τις θέλων ὁδὸν ὁδεύειν ἐπὶ τὸν ὡρισμένον τόπον, σπεύσῃ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ. ἔστιν οὖν ἡ δοθεῖσα ἡμῖν γνῶσις τοῦ περιπατεῖν ἐν αὐτῇ τοιαύτη. ἀγαπήσεις τὸν ποιήσαντά σε, φοβηθήσῃ τόν σε πλάσαντα, δοξάσεις τόν σε λυτρωσάμενον ἐκ θανάτου: ἔσῃ ἁπλοῦς τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ πλούσιος τῷ πνεύματι: οὐ κολληθήσῃ μετὰ τῶν πορευομένων ἐν ὁδῷ θανάτου, μισήσεις πᾶν, ὃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀρεστὸν τῷ θεῷ, μισήσεις πᾶσαν ὑπόκρισιν: οὐ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς ἐντολὰς κυρίου. οὐχ ὑψώσεις σεαυτόν, ἔσῃ δὲ ταπεινόφρων κατὰ πάντα: οὐκ ἀρεῖς ἐπὶ σεαυτὸν δόξαν. οὐ λήμψῃ βουλὴν πονηρὰν κατὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου, οὐ δώσεις τῇ ψυχῇ σου θράσος. οὐ πορνεύσεις, οὐ μοιχεύσεις, οὐ παιδοφθορήσεις. οὐ μή σου ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξέλθῃ ἐν ἀκαθαρσίᾳ τινῶν. οὐ λήμψῃ πρόσωπον ἐλέγξαι τινὰ ἐπὶ παραπτώματι. ἔσῃ πραΰς, ἔσῃ ἡσύχιος, ἔσῃ τρέμων τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἤκουσας. οὐ μνησικακήσεις τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου. οὐ μὴ διψυχήσῃς, πότερον ἔσται ἢ οὔ. οὐ μὴ λάβῃς ἐπὶ ματαίῳ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου. ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὑπὲρ τὴν ψυχήν σου. οὐ φονεύσεις τέκνον ἐν φθορᾷ, οὐδὲ πάλιν γεννηθὲν ἀποκτενεῖς. οὐ μὴ ἄρῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου ἀπὸ τοῦ υἱοῦ σου ἡ ἀπὸ τῆς θυγατρός σου, ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ νεότητος διδάξεις φόβου θεοῦ. οὐ μὴ γένῃ ἐπιθυμῶν τὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου, οὐ μὴ γένῃ πλεονέκτης. οὐδὲ κολληθήσῃ ἐκ ψυχῆς σου μετὰ ὑψηλῶν, ἀλλὰ μετὰ ταπεινῶν καὶ δικαίων ἀναστραφήσῃ. τὰ συμβαίνοντά σοι ἐνεργήματα ὡς ἀγαθὰ προσδέξῃ, εἰδώς, ὅτι ἄνευ θεοῦ οὐδὲν γίνεται. οὐκ ἔσῃ διγνώμων οὐδὲ γλωσσώδης, ὑποταγήσῃ κυρίοις ὡς τύπῳ θεοῦ ἐν αἰσχύνῃ καὶ φόβῳ: οὐ μὴ ἐπιτάξῃς δούλῳ σου ἡ παιδίσκῃ ἐν πικρίᾳ, τοῖς ἐπὶ τὸν αὐτὸν θεὸν ἐλπίζουσιν, μή ποτε οὐ μὴ φοβηθήσονται τὸν ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέροις θεόν: ὅτι οὐκ ἦλθεν κατὰ πρόσωπον καλέσαι, ἀλλ’ ἐφ̓ οὓς τὸ πνεῦμα ἡτοίμασεν. κοινωνήσεις ἐν πᾶσιν τῷ πλησίον σου καὶ οὐκ ἐρεῖς ἴδια εἶναι: εἰ γὰρ ἐν τῷ ἀφθάρτῳ κοινωνοί ἐστε, πόσῳ μᾶλλον ἐν τοῖς φθαρτοῖς; οὐκ ἔσῃ πρόγλωσσος: παγὶς γὰρ τὸ στόμα θανάτου. ὅσον δύνασαι, ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς σου ἁγνεύσεις. μὴ γίνου πρὸς μὲν τὸ λαβεῖν ἐκτείνων τὰς χεῖρας, πρὸς δὲ τὸ δοῦναι συσπῶν. ἀγαπήσεις ὡς κόρην τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σου πάντα τὸν λαλοῦντά σοι τὸν λόγον κυρίου. μνησθήσῃ ἡμέραν κρίσεως νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας, καὶ ἐκζητήσεις καθ̓ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν τὰ πρόσωπα τῶν ἁγίων, ἢ διὰ λόγου κοπιῶν καὶ πορευόμενος εἰς τὸ παρακαλέσαι καὶ μελετῶν εἰς τὸ σῶσαι ψυχὴν τῷ λόγῳ, ἢ διὰ τῶν χειρῶν σου ἐργάσῃ εἰς λύτρωσιν ἁμαρτιῶν σου. οὐ διστάσεις δοῦναι οὐδὲ διδοὺς γογγύσεις: γνώσῃ δέ, τίς ὁ τοῦ μισθοῦ καλὸς ἀνταποδότης. φυλάξεις ἃ παρέλαβες, μήτε προστιθεὶς μήτε ἀφαιρῶν. εἰς τέλος μισήσεις τὸ πονηρόν. κρινεῖς δικαίως. οὐ ποιήσεις σχίσμα, εἰρηνεύσεις δὲ μαχομένους συναγαγών. ἐξομολογήσῃ ἐπὶ ἁμαρτίαις σου. οὐ προσήξεις ἐπὶ προσευχὴν ἐν συνειδήσει πονηρᾷ. αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ὁδὸς, τοῦ φωτός.
pass_a_gloss: The path of light is this: if someone wanting to travel the path to the appointed destination, hurries with his works. The knowledge given to us to walk in it is such. You will love the one who made you, you will fear the one who created you, you will glorify the one who redeemed you from death: you will be single-hearted and rich in spirit: you will not cling to those who walk on the path of death, you will hate everything that is not pleasing to God, you will hate all hypocrisy: you will not abandon the commands of the Lord. You will not exalt yourself, but you will be humble in all things: you will not claim glory for yourself. You will not devise evil plans against your neighbor, you will not give your soul boldness. You will not commit adultery, you will not commit fornication, you will not corrupt children. The word of God will not come out of your mouth in uncleanness. You will not take a face to rebuke someone for a transgression. You will be gentle, you will be peaceful, you will be trembling at the words you have heard. You will not be resentful towards your brother. You will not be double-minded, whether something will be or not. You will not take the name of the Lord in vain. You will love your neighbor more than your own soul. You will not kill a child by abortion, nor again will you kill a born child. You will not withdraw your hand from your son or your daughter, but from youth you will teach them the fear of God. You will not be covetous of your neighbor's things, you will not be greedy. You will not cling to the high-minded, but you will associate with the humble and the righteous. You will accept the things that happen to you as good, knowing that nothing happens without God. You will not be double-tongued or hypocritical, you will submit to your masters as to a type of God in shame and fear: you will not command your slave or servant with bitterness, to those who hope in the same God, lest they not fear the God who is over both: because He did not come to call according to appearance, but to those whom the Spirit has prepared. You will share everything with your neighbor and not claim anything as your own: for if you are sharers in the imperishable, how much more in the perishable things? You will not be a gossip: for the mouth is a snare of death. As much as you can, you will sanctify yourself above your soul. You will not be one who stretches out your hands to receive, but clenches them to give. You will love everyone who speaks the word of the Lord to you as the apple of your eye. You will remember the day of judgment night and day, and you will seek the faces of the saints every day, either by laboring in word and going to exhort and meditating to save a soul with the word, or by working with your hands for the redemption of your sins. You will not hesitate to give, nor will you grumble when giving: you will know that the good rewarder is the one who gives. You will keep what you have received, neither adding nor subtracting. You will hate evil to the end. You will judge justly. You will not create divisions, but you will make peace between those who are fighting, gathering them together. You will confess your sins. You will not approach prayer with an evil conscience. This is the path of light.

pass_b_english: This is the path of light: if anyone wants to travel the road that leads to the appointed destination, let them press on with their works. The knowledge given to us for walking in it is this: You will love the one who made you, you will fear the one who formed you, you will glorify the one who redeemed you from death. You will be single-hearted and rich in spirit. You will not cling to those who walk on the path of death. You will hate everything that is not pleasing to God; you will hate all hypocrisy. You will not abandon the Lord's commands. You will not exalt yourself; instead you will be humble in all things. You will not claim glory for yourself. You will not devise evil plans against your neighbor, and you will not give your soul boldness. You will not commit sexual immorality, you will not commit adultery, you will not corrupt children. The word of God will not come out of your mouth in any impurity. You will not show partiality when you rebuke someone for a transgression. You will be gentle, you will be peaceful, you will tremble at the words you have heard. You will not hold a grudge against your brother. You will not be double-minded, wavering over whether something will happen or not. You will not take the Lord's name in vain. You will love your neighbor more than your own soul. You will not kill a child by abortion, nor will you kill a child after it is born. You will not withdraw your hand from your son or your daughter, but from youth you will teach them the fear of God. You will not covet your neighbor's possessions, you will not be greedy. You will not attach yourself to the high-minded, but you will associate with the humble and the righteous. You will accept the things that happen to you as good, knowing that nothing happens without God. You will not be two-faced or hypocritical. You will submit to your masters as to a type of God, in shame and fear. You will not command your slave or servant with bitterness, those who hope in the same God, lest they fail to fear the God who is over both. For he did not come to call according to outward appearance, but those whom the Spirit has prepared. You will share everything with your neighbor and not claim anything as your own. For if you are partners in the imperishable, how much more in perishable things? You will not be a gossip, for the mouth is a snare of death. As much as you can, you will sanctify yourself for the sake of your soul. You will not be one who stretches out your hands to receive but clenches them when it is time to give. You will love everyone who speaks the word of the Lord to you as the apple of your eye. You will remember the day of judgment night and day, and you will seek out the faces of the saints every day, either by laboring in word and going to exhort and meditating to save a soul by the word, or by working with your hands for the redemption of your sins. You will not hesitate to give, nor will you grumble when giving. You will know who is the good rewarder. You will keep what you have received, neither adding nor subtracting. You will hate evil to the end. You will judge justly. You will not create divisions, but you will make peace between those who are fighting, gathering them together. You will confess your sins. You will not approach prayer with an evil conscience. This is the path of light.
